Table of Contents Shrutika Patil September 24, 2026 10:00 am Pallavi Shillar’s career journey shows how focused learning and practical exposure can help you take a confident step into the IT industry. With an interest in building websites and understanding front-end development, she decided to strengthen her technical skills through structured training. Pallavi joined the Front End Development course in Pune at 3RI Technologies , where she learned HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap through practical Software testing training in Pune and projects. Regular practice and assignments helped her build confidence in front-end technologies and prepare for professional opportunities. The Challenge For Pallavi, learning front-end development was not just about understanding coding concepts. She wanted to learn how different technologies work together to create functional and user-friendly websites. She was looking for a structured learning environment where she could strengthen her basics, practice regularly, and gain confidence through practical work. She joined the Front End Development Course in Pune to learn technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap and apply them through practical development tasks. The Learning Approach at 3RI Technologies Pallavi wanted to learn front-end development in a structured and practical way. She joined the Front End Development Course in Pune at 3RI Technologies , a 2.5-month program covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap. The course also includes project-based learning, allowing her to apply the concepts she learned through practical work. Along with technical training, Pallavi received support through projects, resume preparation, interview preparation, certification, and job assistance . This practical approach helped her improve her technical understanding, gain confidence, and prepare for opportunities in the IT industry. Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Email Phone Send The Front-End Development Training Path Pallavi’s learning journey focused on understanding front-end development step by step and using each concept in practice. Through structured training at 3RI Technologies , she learned important web technologies and got practical experience along the way. Week 1 – Getting Started with HTML: Pallavi began with HTML and learned how the basic structure of a website is created using different elements, links, images, forms, and other page components. Week 2 – Styling with CSS: She moved on to CSS and explored layouts, fonts, colors, spacing, borders, positioning, and other styling concepts used to improve the appearance of web pages. Week 3 – Learning JavaScript: The next stage introduced her to JavaScript fundamentals, including variables, conditions, loops, functions, events, and validations. This helped her understand how interactive features work on websites. Week 4 – jQuery and Bootstrap: Pallavi learned how jQuery can be used for interactive web elements and explored Bootstrap for creating structured and responsive layouts. Week 5 – Practical Work and Projects: She applied the concepts she had learned through assignments and projects. This gave her an opportunity to practice her skills and understand how different technologies work together. Week 6 – Career Preparation: Along with improving her technical knowledge, Pallavi worked on interview preparation and career-related activities, helping her become more confident while preparing for professional opportunities. By learning these topics step by step and getting practical experience, Pallavi improved her front-end development skills and became ready to begin her professional journey as a Software Engineer Associate at VISH OLMEDIA, Kharadi, Pune . The Outcome of Front-End Development Training in Pune The Front-End Development training at 3RI Technologies helped Pallavi improve her web development skills and gain practical experience. Regular practice, assignments, and projects gave her a better understanding of how front-end technologies are used while creating websites.The Placement at 3RI Technologies helped Pallavi take the next step after completing her training and begin her career in IT.
